title: "Unit 2 Task 4"
format: html
---

```{python}
import polars as pl
import numpy as np
from lets_plot import *

LetsPlot.setup_html(isolated_frame=True)

df = pl.read_csv('https://byuistats.github.io/M335/data/rcw_reshape.csv')
display(df)
```


# replace null with 0
```{python}
df_wide = df.pivot(on="Department", values="Count")
df_wide = df_wide.with_columns(
    pl.col(pl.NUMERIC_DTYPES).fill_null(0)
)
display(df_wide)
```

# if you dont want to see alllll of the columns, use index=[...]
```{python}
df_long = df_wide.unpivot(
    on=['Chem', 'CSEE', 'DCM', 'GEO', 'Math', 'ME', 'PHY'], 
    variable_name="Department", 
    value_name="Count",
    index=["Year", "Semester", "Semester_Date"]
)
display(df_long)
```


```{python}
(
    ggplot(data=df_long, mapping=aes(x="Semester_Date", y="Count", color="Department"))
    + geom_line()
)
```

```{python}
print(f"original df: {df.shape}")
print(f"wide df: {df_wide.shape}")
print(f"long df: {df_long.shape}")
```


```{python}
(
    ggplot(data=df_long, mapping=aes(x="Semester_Date", y="Count", color="Department"))
    + geom_line()
    + facet_wrap("Department")

    + labs(
        x = "", 
        y = ""
    )
)
```
